  /* ---------- Modals ---------- */
  .overlay {
    position: fixed;
    z-index: 120;

  }
  @keyframes overlayIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } }
  .dialog {
    position: relative;

    height: 27px;

    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 900;

  .step p { margin: 0; color: #667069; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.45; }
  .shortcuts {
    display: flex;

  .shortcuts kbd {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 2px 5px;
    border: 1px solid rgba(20,32,27,.35);

    border-radius: 5px;
    background: #fffdf8;

    font-size: 12px;

  #victoryModal .dialog {

  }
  @keyframes confettiFly {
    0% { opacity: 1; transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(0deg) scale(1); }

        if (ELEMENTS[id] && !discovered.includes(id)) discovered.push(id);
      }

      const order = [];
      for (const id of BASE) order.push(id);
      const savedOrder = Array.isArray(saved.discoveryOrder) ? saved.discoveryOrder : saved.discovered;
      for (const id of savedOrder) {
        if (ELEMENTS[id] && !order.includes(id)) order.push(id);
      }
      for (const id of discovered) {
        if (!order.includes(id)) order.push(id);
      }

      const board = [];
      if (Array.isArray(saved.board)) {
        for (const item of saved.board) {
          if (!item || !ELEMENTS[item.elementId]) continue;
          const x = Number(item.x);
          const y = Number(item.y);
          if (!Number.isFinite(x) || !Number.isFinite(y)) continue;
          board.push({ cid: ++cidSeq, elementId: item.elementId, x, y });
        }
      }

      state = {
        discovered,
        discoveryOrder: order,
        board,
        sound: saved.sound !== false,
        goalSeen: !!saved.goalSeen,
        hasSaved: true
      };
    } else {
      state = {
        discovered: [...BASE],
        discoveryOrder: [...BASE],
        board: [],
        sound: true,
        goalSeen: false,
        hasSaved: false
      };
    }
  }

  function save() {
    try {
      const data = {
        v: 1,
        discovered: state.discovered,
        discoveryOrder: state.discoveryOrder,
        board: state.board.map(card => ({
          elementId: card.elementId,
          x: Number(card.x.toFixed(5)),
          y: Number(card.y.toFixed(5))
        })),
        sound: state.sound,
        goalSeen: state.goalSeen
      };
      localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(data));
    } catch (err) {
      // El juego sigue funcionando sin persistencia.
    }
  }

  function clampPosition(x, y, el) {
    const bw = els.board.clientWidth;
    const bh = els.board.clientHeight;
    if (!bw || !bh) return { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 };
    const w = el ? el.offsetWidth : 130;
    const h = el ? el.offsetHeight : 46;
    const padX = (w / 2 + 12) / bw;
    const padY = (h / 2 + 12) / bh;
    return {
      x: padX > 0.48 ? 0.5 : Math.min(1 - padX, Math.max(padX, x)),
      y: padY > 0.48 ? 0.5 : Math.min(1 - padY, Math.max(padY, y))
    };
  }

  function positionCard(card) {
    if (!card.el) return;
    card.el.style.left = (card.x * 100) + '%';
    card.el.style.top = (card.y * 100) + '%';
  }

  function createCard(card) {
    const data = element(card.elementId);
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'card cat-' + data.cat;
    el.dataset.cid = String(card.cid);
    el.tabIndex = 0;
    el.setAttribute('role', 'button');
    el.setAttribute('aria-label', data.name + '. Arrastra o pulsa para mezclar.');
    el.title = data.name + ' — ' + data.blurb;
    el.style.setProperty('--tilt', tiltFor(card.elementId) + 'deg');

    const emoji = document.createElement('span');
    emoji.className = 'emoji';
    emoji.textContent = data.emoji;
    emoji.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

    const name = document.createElement('span');
    name.className = 'name';
    name.textContent = data.name;

    el.appendChild(emoji);
    el.appendChild(name);
    els.cards.appendChild(el);
    card.el = el;
    cardEls.set(card.cid, el);

    const p = clampPosition(card.x, card.y, el);
    card.x = p.x;
    card.y = p.y;
    positionCard(card);

    el.addEventListener('pointerdown', onCardPointerDown);
    el.addEventListener('dblclick', onCardDoubleClick);
    el.addEventListener('keydown', onCardKeyDown);

    return el;
  }

  function addCard(elementId, x, y, options = {}) {
    if (!ELEMENTS[elementId]) return null;
    const card = { cid: ++cidSeq, elementId, x, y, el: null };
    createCard(card);
    state.board.push(card);
    if (options.animate !== false) {
      card.el.classList.add('spawn');
      setTimeout(() => card.el && card.el.classList.remove('spawn'), 320);
    }
    if (options.select) {
      selectCard(card);
    }
    if (!options.noSave) save();
    return card;
  }

  function removeCard(cid, animate = true) {
    const index = state.board.findIndex(card => card.cid === cid);
    if (index === -1) return;
    const card = state.board[index];
    state.board.splice(index, 1);
    const el = cardEls.get(cid);
    if (el) {
      cardEls.delete(cid);
      el.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
      if (animate) {
        el.classList.add('leaving');
        setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 160);
      } else {
        el.remove();
      }
    }
    if (selectedCid === cid) {
      selectedCid = null;
    }
  }

  function seedBoard() {
    if (state.board.length) return;
    const compact = els.board.clientWidth < 680;
    const dx = compact ? 0.21 : 0.15;
    const dy = compact ? 0.13 : 0.105;
    const positions = [
      [-dx, -dy],
      [dx, -dy],
      [-dx, dy],
      [dx, dy]
    ];
    BASE.forEach((id, index) => {
      addCard(id, 0.5 + positions[index][0], 0.5 + positions[index][1], { animate: false, noSave: true });
    });
    save();
  }

  function clearSelection() {
    if (selectedCid !== null) {
      const el = cardEls.get(selectedCid);
      if (el) el.classList.remove('selected');
      selectedCid = null;
    }
  }

  function selectCard(card) {
    clearSelection();
    selectedCid = card.cid;
    if (card.el) card.el.classList.add('selected');
  }

  function handleCardActivate(card) {
    if (!card) return;
    if (selectedCid !== null && selectedCid !== card.cid) {
      const source = getCard(selectedCid);
      if (source) {
        attemptCombine(source, card);
        return;
      }
      clearSelection();
    }
    if (selectedCid === card.cid) {
      clearSelection();
    } else {
      selectCard(card);
    }
  }

  function onCardKeyDown(event) {
    if (event.key !== 'Enter' && event.key !== ' ') return;
    event.preventDefault();
    const card = getCardFromEl(event.currentTarget);
    handleCardActivate(card);
  }

  function onCardDoubleClick(event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    event.stopPropagation();
    const card = getCardFromEl(event.currentTarget);
    if (!card) return;
    const offset = 0.055;
    let nx = card.x + offset;
    let ny = card.y + offset;
    if (nx > 0.86) nx = card.x - offset;
    if (ny > 0.84) ny = card.y - offset;
    addCard(card.elementId, nx, ny, { select: false });
    showToast('Copia añadida al tablero.', 'info', 1200);
    beep(660, 0.04, 0, 'sine', 0.018);
  }

  function onCardPointerDown(event) {
    if (event.pointerType === 'mouse' && event.button !== 0) return;
    const el = event.currentTarget;
    const card = getCardFromEl(el);
    if (!card) return;

    event.preventDefault();
    clearDropTargets();

    const boardRect = els.board.getBoundingClientRect();
    const cardRect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
    drag = {
      card,
      el,
      pointerId: event.pointerId,
      startClientX: event.clientX,
      startClientY: event.clientY,
      grabDX: (event.clientX - (cardRect.left + cardRect.width / 2)) / boardRect.width,
      grabDY: (event.clientY - (cardRect.top + cardRect.height / 2)) / boardRect.height,
      origX: card.x,
      origY: card.y,
      moved: false,
      targetCid: null
    };

    el.classList.add('dragging');
    el.style.zIndex = String(++zTop);
    try { el.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* noop */ }

    window.addEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove, { passive: false });
    window.addEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
    window.addEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerUp);
  }

  function onPointerMove(event) {
    if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
    const dx = event.clientX - drag.startClientX;
    const dy = event.clientY - drag.startClientY;

    if (!drag.moved && Math.hypot(dx, dy) > 5) {
      drag.moved = true;
      clearSelection();
    }
    if (!drag.moved) return;

    event.preventDefault();
    const boardRect = els.board.getBoundingClientRect();
    let x = (event.clientX - boardRect.left) / boardRect.width - drag.grabDX;
    let y = (event.clientY - boardRect.top) / boardRect.height - drag.grabDY;
    const p = clampPosition(x, y, drag.el);
    drag.card.x = p.x;
    drag.card.y = p.y;
    positionCard(drag.card);

    const targetCid = findDropTarget(drag.el);
    if (targetCid !== drag.targetCid) {
      clearDropTargets();
      drag.targetCid = targetCid;
      if (targetCid !== null) {
        const targetEl = cardEls.get(targetCid);
        if (targetEl) targetEl.classList.add('drop-target');
      }
    }
  }

  function onPointerUp(event) {
    if (!drag || event.pointerId !== drag.pointerId) return;
    const current = drag;
    drag = null;

    window.removeEventListener('pointermove', onPointerMove);
    window.removeEventListener('pointerup', onPointerUp);
    window.removeEventListener('pointercancel', onPointerUp);

    const el = current.el;
    el.classList.remove('dragging');
    try { el.releasePointerCapture(event.pointerId); } catch (err) { /* noop */ }

    const targetCid = findDropTarget(el);
    clearDropTargets();

    if (current.moved) {
      if (targetCid !== null) {
        const target = getCard(targetCid);
        if (target) {
          attemptCombine(current.card, target, { returnTo: { x: current.origX, y: current.origY } });
          return;
        }
      }
      save();
    } else {
      handleCardActivate(current.card);
    }
  }

  function findDropTarget(dragEl) {
    if (!dragEl) return null;
    const dragRect = dragEl.getBoundingClientRect();
    let bestCid = null;
    let bestArea = 0;

    for (const card of state.board) {
      if (card.cid === Number(dragEl.dataset.cid)) continue;
      const el = cardEls.get(card.cid);
      if (!el || el.classList.contains('leaving')) continue;
      const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect();
      const overlapX = Math.max(0, Math.min(dragRect.right, rect.right) - Math.max(dragRect.left, rect.left));
      const overlapY = Math.max(0, Math.min(dragRect.bottom, rect.bottom) - Math.max(dragRect.top, rect.top));
      const area = overlapX * overlapY;
      if (area > bestArea) {
        bestArea = area;
        bestCid = card.cid;
      }
    }
    return bestCid;
  }

  function clearDropTargets() {
    $$('.card.drop-target', els.cards).forEach(el => el.classList.remove('drop-target'));
  }

  function attemptCombine(a, b, options = {}) {
    if (!a || !b || a.cid === b.cid) return;
    clearSelection();
    clearDropTargets();

    const resultId = RECIPE_MAP.get(pairKey(a.elementId, b.elementId));
    if (!resultId) {
      invalidCombine(a, b, options);
      return;
    }

    const x = (a.x + b.x) / 2;
    const y = (a.y + b.y) / 2;
    const wasNew = !isDiscovered(resultId);

    removeCard(a.cid);
    removeCard(b.cid);
    if (wasNew) discoverElement(resultId);

    const card = addCard(resultId, x, y, { animate: true });
    if (!card) return;

    if (wasNew) {
      announceDiscovery(resultId, card);
    } else {
      showToast('Has creado <b>' + element(resultId).name + '</b>.', 'info', 1900);
      playCombine();
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (!card.el) return;
        const rect = card.el.getBoundingClientRect();
        burst(rect.left + rect.width / 2, rect.top + rect.height / 2, 10, 0.65);
      }, 20);
    }

    if (isDiscovered('atlas') && !state.goalSeen) {
      state.goalSeen = true;
      save();
      setTimeout(showVictory, 620);
    } else {
      save();
    }
  }

  function invalidCombine(a, b, options) {
    clearSelection();
    if (options && options.returnTo && a.el) {
      a.el.classList.add('returning');
      a.x = options.returnTo.x;
      a.y = options.returnTo.y;
      const p = clampPosition(a.x, a.y, a.el);
      a.x = p.x;
      a.y = p.y;
      positionCard(a);
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (a.el) a.el.classList.remove('returning');
        save();
      }, 270);
    } else {
      save();
    }
    shake(a.el);
    shake(b.el);
    showToast(FAIL_LINES[Math.floor(Math.random() * FAIL_LINES.length)], 'warn', 2200);
    playInvalid();
  }

  function shake(el) {
    if (!el) return;
    el.classList.remove('shake');
    void el.offsetWidth;
    el.classList.add('shake');
    setTimeout(() => el.classList.remove('shake'), 420);
  }

  function discoverElement(id) {
    if (!ELEMENTS[id] || isDiscovered(id)) return false;
    state.discovered.push(id);
    if (!state.discoveryOrder.includes(id)) state.discoveryOrder.push(id);
    recentId = id;
    if (recentTimer) clearTimeout(recentTimer);
    recentTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      recentId = null;
      const mini = $('.mini[data-element="' + id + '"]', els.discoveries);
      if (mini) mini.classList.remove('is-recent');
    }, 2600);
    renderSidebar();
    updateProgress();
    updateMission();
    save();
    return true;
  }

  function announceDiscovery(id, card) {
    const data = element(id);
    els.bannerEmoji.textContent = data.emoji;
    els.bannerName.textContent = data.name;
    els.bannerBlurb.textContent = data.blurb;
    els.banner.classList.add('show');
    if (bannerTimer) clearTimeout(bannerTimer);
    bannerTimer = setTimeout(() => els.banner.classList.remove('show'), 4200);

    if (card && card.el) {
      card.el.classList.add('is-new');
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (card.el) card.el.classList.remove('is-new');
      }, 900);
      setTimeout(() => {
        if (!card.el) return;
        const rect = card.el.getBoundingClientRect();
        burst(rect.left + rect.width / 2, rect.top + rect.height / 2, 26, 1);
      }, 20);
    }
    playDiscovery();
  }

  function renderSidebar() {
    if (!els.discoveries) return;
    const query = normalize(els.search.value.trim());
    const all = state.discoveryOrder
      .filter(id => isDiscovered(id))
      .slice()
      .reverse();

    const filtered = query
      ? all.filter(id => normalize(element(id).name).includes(query) || normalize(element(id).blurb).includes(query))
      : all;

    if (!filtered.length) {
      const empty = document.createElement('div');
      empty.className = 'empty-store';
      empty.innerHTML = '<span class="big" aria-hidden="true">🧪</span><span>No hay nada con ese nombre.<br>Prueba otra búsqueda.</span>';
      els.discoveries.replaceChildren(empty);
    } else {
      const fragment = document.createDocumentFragment();
      for (const id of filtered) {
        const data = element(id);
        const button = document.createElement('button');
        button.type = 'button';
        button.className = 'mini cat-' + data.cat;
        button.dataset.element = id;
        button.title = data.name + ' — ' + data.blurb;
        button.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Añadir ' + data.name + ' al tablero');
        if (id === recentId) button.classList.add('is-recent');

        const emoji = document.createElement('span');
        emoji.className = 'emoji';
        emoji.textContent = data.emoji;
        emoji.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

        const name = document.createElement('span');
        name.className = 'name';
        name.textContent = data.name;

        const plus = document.createElement('span');
        plus.className = 'plus';
        plus.textContent = '+';
        plus.setAttribute('aria-hidden', 'true');

        button.appendChild(emoji);
        button.appendChild(name);
        button.appendChild(plus);
        fragment.appendChild(button);
      }
      els.discoveries.replaceChildren(fragment);
    }

    const countText = state.discovered.length + ' de ' + TOTAL;
    els.sideCount.textContent = countText;
    els.totalCount.textContent = String(TOTAL);
  }

  function updateProgress() {
    const count = state.discovered.length;
    const pct = Math.round((count / TOTAL) * 100);
    els.discoveredCount.textContent = String(count);
    els.totalCount.textContent = String(TOTAL);
    els.sideCount.textContent = count + ' de ' + TOTAL;
    els.progressPill.classList.toggle('is-done', count === TOTAL);
    els.missionBar.style.width = Math.max(4, pct) + '%';
    els.missionPercent.textContent = pct + '%';
  }

  function updateMission() {
    const done = isDiscovered('atlas');
    els.missionChip.classList.toggle('done', done);
    els.missionText.textContent = done ? 'Atlas Malandriner desbloqueado' : 'Descubre el Atlas Malandriner';
    els.missionCheck.textContent = done ? '✓' : '○';
  }

  function showToast(html, type = 'info', duration = 2600) {
    els.toast.className = 'toast show ' + type;
    els.toast.innerHTML = html;
    if (toastTimer) clearTimeout(toastTimer);
    toastTimer = setTimeout(() => els.toast.classList.remove('show'), duration);
  }

  function giveHint() {
    const available = RECIPES.filter(([a, b, result]) => isDiscovered(a) && isDiscovered(b) && !isDiscovered(result));
    if (!available.length) {
      if (state.discovered.length >= TOTAL) {
        showToast('¡Laboratorio completo! Has descubierto las ' + TOTAL + ' piezas. 🏆', 'ok', 4800);
        burst(window.innerWidth / 2, window.innerHeight / 2, 40, 1.35);
        playWin();
      } else {
        showToast('No hay pistas nuevas con lo que tienes. Sigue mezclando.', 'warn', 3200);
      }
      return;
    }

    const pick = available[Math.floor(Math.random() * available.length)];
    const [a, b, result] = pick;
    showToast('💡 Prueba <b>' + element(a).name + '</b> + <b>' + element(b).name + '</b>', 'hint', 5200);
    pulseElements([a, b]);
    beep(740, 0.05, 0, 'sine', 0.02);
    beep(980, 0.06, 0.06, 'sine', 0.02);
    if (els.search.value.trim()) {
      els.search.value = '';
      renderSidebar();
    }
    if (window.innerWidth <= 900) closeSidebar();
    // La pista debe seguir siendo útil aunque el resultado sea nuevo.
    void result;
  }

  function pulseElements(ids) {
    for (const id of ids) {
      for (const card of state.board) {
        if (card.elementId !== id || !card.el) continue;
        card.el.classList.remove('hint-pulse');
        void card.el.offsetWidth;
        card.el.classList.add('hint-pulse');
        setTimeout(() => {
          if (card.el) card.el.classList.remove('hint-pulse');
        }, 1900);
      }
      const mini = $('.mini[data-element="' + id + '"]', els.discoveries);
      if (mini) {
        mini.classList.remove('hint-pulse');
        void mini.offsetWidth;
        mini.classList.add('hint-pulse');
        setTimeout(() => mini.classList.remove('hint-pulse'), 1900);
      }
    }
  }

  function spawnFromStore(id) {
    if (!ELEMENTS[id]) return;
    const n = state.board.length;
    const angle = n * 2.399963229728653;
    const radius = Math.min(0.17, 0.05 + n * 0.008);
    const x = 0.5 + Math.cos(angle) * radius;
    const y = 0.5 + Math.sin(angle) * radius;
    addCard(id, x, y, { animate: true });
    beep(520, 0.035, 0, 'sine', 0.014);
    if (window.innerWidth <= 900) closeSidebar();
  }

  function openSidebar() {
    document.body.classList.add('sidebar-open');
  }

  function closeSidebar() {
    document.body.classList.remove('sidebar-open');
  }

  function toggleSidebar() {
    if (document.body.classList.contains('sidebar-open')) closeSidebar();
    else openSidebar();
  }

  function openModal(modal) {
    lastFocus = document.activeElement;
    closeSidebar();
    modal.hidden = false;
    const close = $('[data-close]', modal);
    setTimeout(() => {
      if (close) close.focus();
    }, 20);
  }

  function closeModal(modal) {
    modal.hidden = true;
    if (lastFocus && typeof lastFocus.focus === 'function') {
      try { lastFocus.focus(); } catch (err) { /* noop */ }
    }
  }

  function closeAllModals() {
    for (const modal of [els.helpModal, els.resetModal, els.victoryModal]) {
      if (!modal.hidden) modal.hidden = true;
    }
  }

  function openHelp() {
    openModal(els.helpModal);
  }

  function openReset() {
    const count = state.discovered.length;
    els.resetText.textContent = count > BASE.length
      ? 'Se borrarán tus ' + count + ' descubrimientos y el tablero volverá a las cuatro piezas iniciales. Esta acción no se puede deshacer.'
      : 'El tablero volverá a las cuatro piezas iniciales. Esta acción no se puede deshacer.';
    openModal(els.resetModal);
  }

  function showVictory() {
    els.vDisc.textContent = String(state.discovered.length);
    openModal(els.victoryModal);
    const centerX = window.innerWidth / 2;
    const centerY = window.innerHeight * 0.36;
    burst(centerX, centerY, 44, 1.4);
    setTimeout(() => burst(window.innerWidth * 0.22, centerY, 24, 1.1), 180);
    setTimeout(() => burst(window.innerWidth * 0.78, centerY, 24, 1.1), 320);
    playWin();
  }

  function resetGame() {
    try { localStorage.removeItem(STORAGE_KEY); } catch (err) { /* noop */ }
    const sound = state.sound;
    state = {
      discovered: [...BASE],
      discoveryOrder: [...BASE],
      board: [],
      sound,
      goalSeen: false,
      hasSaved: true
    };
    cidSeq = 0;
    selectedCid = null;
    drag = null;
    cardEls.clear();
    els.cards.replaceChildren();
    closeAllModals();
    seedBoard();
    renderSidebar();
    updateProgress();
    updateMission();
    save();
    showToast('Laboratorio reiniciado. Otra vez desde cero.', 'ok', 2600);
    beep(440, 0.06, 0, 'sine', 0.02);
    beep(620, 0.08, 0.07, 'sine', 0.02);
  }

  /* ---------- Audio ---------- */
  function getAudio() {
    if (!state.sound) return null;
    const AudioCtor = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
    if (!AudioCtor) return null;
    try {
      if (!audioCtx) audioCtx = new AudioCtor();
      if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
      return audioCtx;
    } catch (err) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function beep(freq, duration = 0.07, delay = 0, type = 'sine', volume = 0.028) {
    const ctx = getAudio();
    if (!ctx) return;
    const start = ctx.currentTime + delay;
    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, start);
    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, start);
    gain.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(volume, start + 0.008);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, start + duration);
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
    osc.start(start);
    osc.stop(start + duration + 0.02);
  }

  function playCombine() {
    beep(420, 0.05, 0, 'sine', 0.022);
    beep(650, 0.07, 0.055, 'sine', 0.022);
